problems.detail: "It pushes its own exhaust, so it works when the air is gone" runs 13 words, over 12
"The gas is light, it gets flung back fast, and out it goes" runs 13 words, over 12
"Than at sea level, where the air pushes back at the engine's base" runs 13 words, over 12
"It coasts straight on at the same speed, it doesn't stop at all" runs 13 words, over 12
55 lines at 112 bpm sing for about 118 s, outside 120 to 160
8 lines in a row from b-1 on a diagram scene with nothing moving
the key line "Push on an object → it pushes back, equal and opposite" runs 11 words, over 10
the key line "Fuel runs out → no thrust → rocket coasts, same speed" runs 11 words, over 10
